title: Bronze Rewards Card: Making Payments and Managing Your Balance
summary: This document explains Bronze Rewards Card payment rules: a 23‑day grace period on new purchases if you pay the statement balance in full by the due date, 20.49% APR on carried balances with interest starting after the grace period, a 1.0% minimum payment, and a possible $32.50 late fee. It also covers how to make payments (online: Make a Payment → funding account → choose minimum/statement balance/custom → schedule) and tips like enabling reminders to preserve the grace period.
faqs: What is the Bronze Rewards Card grace period and when do I lose it?
